authored_narrative.episode_purpose: The thirteenth real episode asks nothing new of this Story — a spirit's departure and a pass through the boiler room, both motifs this Story has already answered fully, appear once more simply because days keep happening.

scene_spirited_away_river_spirit_departu.purpose: The spirit-departure motif that opened this Story's first real ethical test in Episode 1 appears a fourth time here, carrying no test at all — witnessed, not participated in.
scene_spirited_away_river_spirit_departu.stakes: whether witnessing without participating still counts as presence
scene_spirited_away_river_spirit_departu.opposing_force: none — the scene deliberately asks nothing of Gonagi this time

scene_spirited_away_boiler_room_0065.purpose: A third pass through the boiler room finds it exactly as unremarkable as the second — the room has fully exhausted its narrative utility, and this Story lets it.
scene_spirited_away_boiler_room_0065.stakes: whether a setting can be revisited without needing to justify the revisit
scene_spirited_away_boiler_room_0065.opposing_force: the room's own continued existence, indifferent to how many times this Story returns to it

shot_spirited_00497.intent: A distant, observational framing — Gonagi is present in the frame but not centered in it, watching rather than acting.

shot_spirited_00513.intent: A plain pass-through shot, the third such treatment of this room, with nothing new added to the visual vocabulary.
